newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in sleepy late trading on Thursday.
One local bank dealer said activity was mainly seen in the money market, with overnight money falling to five percent at close from 13.0/14.0 percent at the opening.
She said excess supply drove interbank rates down, but the rupiah remained steady against the dollar in thin trading.
Spot rupiah was at 2,432.75/33.25 at 0925 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.0/31.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,432.0/32.5 and 2,432.25/32.50, respectively.
Dealers said the absence of Singapore players because of a public holiday there slowed down overall trading.
They said sentiment on the rupiah remained cautious due to ongoing worries over possible violence during the campaign for the May 29 general election.
Overnight swap was at 0.33/0.37 and tom/next at 0.83/0.90.
One-month swaps were at 12.0/13.0, two at 25.25/26.00, three at 37.0/37.5 and six at 74.50/75.25 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,409/2,457 on Thursday.
